verify_commands.command:
env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" python -c 'import subprocess
paths=["infra/compose/docker-compose.yml","infra/compose/Dockerfile.gerrit","infra/compose/Dockerfile.mcp","infra/compose/Dockerfile.opcert","infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot","infra/compose/gerrit.config"]
def payload(rev,path):
 raw=subprocess.check_output(["git","show",f"{rev}:{path}"],text=True)
 return [line for line in raw.splitlines(keepends=True) if line.strip() and not (line.lstrip().startswith("#") and not line.lstrip().startswith("#!")) and not (path.endswith("gerrit.config") and line.lstrip().startswith(";"))]
for path in paths: assert payload("HEAD^",path)==payload("HEAD",path),path
changed=set(subprocess.check_output(["git","diff","--name-only","HEAD^","HEAD","--","infra/compose"],text=True).splitlines())
assert changed==set(paths),(changed,set(paths))'
